about.description: Validate and Run GitHub Actions locally.
about.head: 7234f17

name: wrkflw v0.9.0
body:
## What's Changed
- Prepare 0.9.0, and fix what the held-out sweep found (#177) (7234f17)
- Pre-release polish: doctor, macOS jobs on the Mac, held-out sweep, prebuilt installs, new demo (#176) (b11b73e)
- Pre-release: JavaScript actions, private uses, prebuilt runner image, stand-in reporting, sweep evidence (#175) (490a508)
- fix: close the gaps left after the compare sweep (#173 follow-up) (#174) (b0fdd8d)
- fix: close the gaps the eight-repo compare sweep found (#173) (48b2075)
- fix: keep what a step installs for the next one, and give jobs the runner's Rust and Docker (#172) (a7e479f)
- fix: agree with GitHub on real repositories, and build job images faster (#171) (7b28427)
- perf: run the legs of a new matrix together, and fit light jobs side by side again (#169) (9889b7d)
- fix: address the review findings from #167 (#168) (a9943e3)
- fix: report what a local pass didn't check, and make local runs match GitHub's (#167) (e418eeb)
- fix: make local verdicts match what GitHub would say (#166) (bcd6c84)
- Make wrkflw a trustworthy feedback loop for agents (#165) (553ecf5)
- fix: address the review of #163 (#164) (5b933c7)
- feat: secret-safe logs, incremental local reruns, live step output and a retro TUI (#163) (79bc82b)
- feat(ui): upgrade to ratatui 0.30 and redesign the TUI (#162) (c029947)
- docs: bring the docs up to date with everything since v0.8.0 (#161) (85d4a9a)
- feat(mcp): register with Copilot CLI, Grok, Kiro, pi and Zed (#160) (1c636c5)
- feat: register with coding agents and record their sessions (#159) (464918d)
- fix: run complex workflows faithfully in containers and stop per-step pulls (#158) (fb7532c)
- fix(executor): close the gaps found reviewing CI acceleration (#157) (f2ec6be)
- feat: spend less on CI with job reuse, job containers and a push gate (#156) (893635f)
- feat(tui): select text with the mouse and copy it on release (#155) (b4628bc)
- fix(tui): stop capturing the mouse so terminal text selection and copy work (#154) (b834ef5)
- fix: close the gaps found testing the agent features (#153) (ac43435)
- feat: make wrkflw usable by coding agents (#152) (a19995c)
- fix(runtime): stop capping steps and leaking timed-out containers (#151) (87e7405)
- fix(gitlab): honor image, rules, when and stage failures (#150) (0bf6a27)
- feat(gitlab): support parallel and parallel:matrix (#149) (76da316)
- fix(artifacts): match upload-artifact path handling (#148) (380291e)
- feat(executor): support continue-on-error on jobs and as an expression (#147) (6034f11)
- fix(reusable): evaluate inputs and honor declared outputs (#146) (98615f7)
- feat(matrix): support expressions for a whole matrix or an axis (#145) (6f6a3c9)
- fix(runtime): report the container's OS and paths to steps (#144) (6f7c664)
- fix(expressions): add arrays, indexing and object filters (#143) (5196caf)
- feat(runtime): add a Kubernetes runtime backend (#142) (153b8ee)
- feat: override runs-on images with --platform (#113) (#141) (6a3eae5)
- feat: support Gitea workflows in .gitea/workflows (#132) (#140) (59cf48c)
- fix(ui): add a light theme for light terminals (#120) (#139) (2a37472)
- fix: use platform base directories instead of ~/.wrkflw (#117) (#138) (5270f7a)
- feat(matrix): support expressions in matrix include and exclude (#112) (#137) (7c00c72)
- fix(ui): clear terminal on TUI startup (#111) (#136) (8cd3bbd)
- fix(gitlab): resolve include, spec:inputs, extends and hidden jobs (#109) (#135) (b533404)
- fix(executor): evaluate job if: against real needs state (#134) (a0f6757)
- fix(executor): skip a job when a job it needs did not succeed (#126) (3952805)
- fix(executor): honour if conditions on composite action steps (#124) (ba8191c)
- fix(executor): harden custom shell script path handling (#133) (6951526)
- fix(executor): honour custom shell specifications in composite actions (#123) (65b067d)
- refactor(ui): drop the write-only WorkflowExecution.logs field (#129) (248a419)
- fix(ui): stop logging the same TUI message to both log sinks (#128) (d061415)
- fix(ui): show real timestamps on diff-filter log lines (#127) (af75913)
- fix(ui): show real timestamps for remaining bare TUI log pushes (#119) (499a4e5)
- feat(runtime): add Auto runtime that detects Docker then Podman (#114) (e5f5fad)
- fix: show correct timestamp in execution tab for all TUI log messages (#116) (c85adc0)
- fix: resolve matrix expressions in step `with` values before execution (#115) (53e83b3)
- fix(executor): deduplicate concurrent runtime image builds (#118) (8bb1653)
